entry.title: New: Bill 217 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 6, ARTICLE 2, SECTION 6-12, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO PROHIBITED HIGHWAYS FOR COMMERCIAL BICYCLE TOURS

Seeks to add a portion of Kohala Mountain Road and a portion of Akoni Pule Highway as prohibited highways for commercial bicycle tours.

Latest action: Council: Bill 217 passes second & final reading - 11/20/2024
